topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes and frames the session around the multi-step mutation model and the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Cascades and Proliferative Autonomy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations across receptor pathways including Wnt, RTK, and TGF-beta drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignancies in both the hematopoietic system and colorectal epithelium arrest terminal cell differentiation.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the molecular regulation of cell death and how mutations affecting p53, Bax, and BCL2 confer apoptosis resistance.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore telomere maintenance mechanisms alongside the protective p53-mediated stress pathways that trigger senescence.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate the Warburg effect, metabolic reprogramming across tissues, and the oncogenic impact of Krebs cycle mutations.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the tumor requirement for neovascularization, the timing of the angiogenic switch, and its regulatory balance.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Detection of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic analyzes the invasion-metastasis cascade, clinical methods for tracking disseminated tumor cells, and the clonal genetics of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarizes the overarching principles of cancer hallmarks, references updated literature, and closes the session.
